instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Regional public health authority responsible for epidemiological surveillance, health promotion programs, and healthcare resource planning for a region of 1.2 million inhabitants. This involves navigating complex state and federal data governance regulations to ensure interoperability across disparate legacy hospital systems.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time grants or service fees to recurring data subscription revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion that secures long-term public sector contracts.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure, though resource allocation between these groups is currently strained.

opportunities.title: Streamlined Data Integration Framework
opportunities.rationale: Develop an incremental enhancement to the existing real-time surveillance tool by automating data ingestion from common legacy systems (e.g., EHRs). This improves reporting efficiency and adoption rates with primary care providers without requiring a total platform overhaul, aligning perfectly with the balanced risk appetite.

first_actions: Audit existing data pipeline bottlenecks across 5 key hospitals.
Define an API standard for third-party integration.
resources_needed: Budget allocation of 4% of the R&D budget
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual data preparation time by 30% within Q3.
milestones: Q3: Pilot integration with one primary care network.

opportunities.title: Predictive Outbreak Modeling Platform (AI/ML)
opportunities.rationale: Invest in a radical shift by developing an AI/ML engine that leverages unstructured syndromic data and environmental factors to predict localized disease outbreaks weeks in advance. This moves the company beyond reactive surveillance into proactive resource allocation, offering massive strategic growth potential but requiring significant cultural change.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional task force (Data Science + Policy).
Allocate 6% of the R&D budget for external ML tooling.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 75% accuracy rate in early warning prediction within the first 2 years of deployment.
milestones: Year 1: Proof-of-concept model deployed on historical data.
Year 2: Full integrated predictive platform readiness.

next_steps.action: Conduct a comprehensive market gap analysis focused on recurring revenue models (subscription vs. one-time grants).
Initiate discovery phase for the Predictive Outbreak Modeling Platform, focusing solely on defining data requirements and regulatory hurdles.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on manual workflows and decentralized documentation across disparate teams.
Informal innovation process leading to inconsistent prioritization and resource waste.
High regulatory risk impeding rapid adoption of advanced digital solutions.
Low perceived customer value for existing self-service features, evidenced by poor adoption rates.
